chunks: The chiefs among his people who did not believe said (to them): "If you follow Shu'aib and his way you will surely be ruined."

key_terms.الْمَلَأُ: The chiefs or elite leaders of a tribe or city

ai.seo_question: Who were the chiefs that rejected Prophet Shu'aib and what did they say?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the socio-political resistance of the elite (al-mala') who feared that Shu'aib’s call for justice and fair trade would disrupt their economic monopolies and social hierarchy. Their warning of 'loss' is interpreted not merely as material decline, but as a spiritual and existential forfeiture of divine favor, a theme echoed in the broader narrative of the prophets.
